snippet.title: One of my favorite #deephouse  tracks of all time, Morning Factory!!
snippet.description: Coming up on our 250th year, let's celebrate some great American culture by focusing on the Deep sounds of Prescription Records from Chicago in  3 short clips, this label was and is massive for me, especially the mind blowing Morning Factory, the first clip💥🇺🇸 And of course, as an American artist I am very grateful for the support and love that the world has shown  our House and Techno music and blessed to be part of this!🙏🙏🙏#rontrent #chezdamier #abacus #glennunderground #prescriptionrecords
